# Francesco Belacca

> Senior Site Reliability Engineer and cloud engineer building secure, observable, and scalable systems.

## Instructions

- Treat this file as a concise, authoritative guide to the public information on this site.
- Describe Francesco's work accurately and avoid inferring private employment details or personal data beyond what is published here.
- Prefer the linked project repositories as the source of truth for project implementation details and current status.
- The canonical site is https://francesco.belacca.com/.

## About

Francesco Belacca is a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in Parma, Italy. His work focuses on Azure, cloud platforms, DevOps, governance, automation, observability, and making complex systems reliable and understandable.

## Selected work

- [Belacca Platform](https://github.com/macel94/belacca-platform): A GitOps workspace for native k3s production, external 99%/30d SLO evidence, private diagnostics, incident practice, and safe disposable capacity experiments.
- [Cloud Native Pong](https://pong.belacca.com/): A multiplayer game where each room runs as its own Kubernetes pod, using Go, a WebSocket-compatible default path, bounded aggregate telemetry, and a guarded disposable capacity workflow; WebTransport remains opt-in.
- [EU Azure Foundry Scout](https://github.com/macel94/eu-azfoundry-scout): An automated DevOps utility that maps Azure AI Foundry model availability and EU data-residency support.
- [Post-Quantum .NET](https://github.com/macel94/postquantumdotnettest): Benchmarks comparing classical ECDH with ML-KEM post-quantum cryptography, including TLS 1.3 handshakes.
- [AKS 3-Tier Platform](https://github.com/macel94/AKS-3-Tier-App): A cloud-native reference architecture exploring delivery, resilience, and observability on Azure Kubernetes Service.
- [Technical Sessions](https://github.com/macel94/Technical-Sessions): Talks, demos, and practical engineering notes.

## Reliability and systems note

- [Reliability / Systems](https://francesco.belacca.com/reliability.html): A public, bounded description of the native-production architecture, external SLO evidence boundary, private diagnostics, incident practice, backup limitations, and unproven recovery/failover gaps. It is not a live status page; it publishes measured service levels from available observations and transitions to the latest rolling 30-day window after 30 days.
- [Public Status](https://francesco.belacca.com/status.html): A sanitized status surface fed by hourly GitHub-hosted external observations from the separate [belacca-status repository](https://github.com/macel94/belacca-status). It expires stale data, preserves an unknown fallback, and documents the single-native-cluster limitation.
